title: One-step simulation configuration identity
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x,y$ be finite binary strings, and choose a simulator state $st$, an input-head position $P$ for $y$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, auxiliary tape contents $\tau_C,\tau_O$, and auxiliary head positions $z_C,z_O$. The simulator machine's one-step successor of the lifted configuration is exactly the result of applying its transition action at that configuration, using the scanned input symbol and the tuple consisting of the symbols under the original work-tape heads and the contents of the auxiliary tapes at their respective head positions.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$P$ is a position among the input-head positions for $y$
